name: Anterior deltoid
actions: flexes the arm at the shoulder
dailyLifeRole: Raises your arm in front of you, such as reaching for a shelf.

review.notes: OpenStax does not split this muscle into parts; the part-level action comes from general anatomy and needs a source check. OpenStax gives actions for the deltoid as a whole (abduction, flexion, extension, rotation). Wikidata Q130243 (identity check).

name: Lateral deltoid
dailyLifeRole: Lifts your arm out to the side.

review.notes: OpenStax calls the deltoid as a whole the major abductor of the arm. Wikidata Q130243 (identity check).

name: Posterior deltoid
actions: extends the arm at the shoulder
dailyLifeRole: Draws your arm back, as when reaching behind or pulling a rope.

review.notes: OpenStax does not split this muscle into parts; the part-level action comes from general anatomy and needs a source check. Wikidata Q130243 (identity check).

name: Supraspinatus
actions: holds the humeral head in the socket
dailyLifeRole: Starts lifting your arm out to the side and steadies the shoulder.

review.notes: Sits above the shoulder blade spine under trapezius, not drawn; nearest slug deltoids. OpenStax states abduction; the initiation role and stabilising function are standard anatomy. Confirm. Wikidata Q74959 (identity check).

name: Infraspinatus
actions: holds the humeral head in the socket
dailyLifeRole: Turns your arm outward, for example when you throw or comb your hair at the back.

review.notes: Lies over the back of the shoulder blade; upper-back is the nearest drawn slug. Wikidata Q19087 (identity check).

name: Teres minor
dailyLifeRole: Turns your arm outward and keeps the shoulder joint steady.

review.notes: Lies over the back of the shoulder blade; upper-back is the nearest drawn slug. Wikidata Q74963 (identity check).

name: Subscapularis
actions: holds the humeral head in the socket
dailyLifeRole: Turns your arm inward, as when you tuck in a shirt, and steadies the front of the shoulder.

review.notes: Lies on the front of the shoulder blade, no matching slug; deltoids used as the nearest slug (K2a may add a slug). Wikidata Q130050 (identity check).

name: Upper trapezius
dailyLifeRole: Shrugs your shoulders and helps lift your arm overhead.

review.notes: OpenStax does not split this muscle into parts; the part-level action comes from general anatomy and needs a source check. OpenStax lists elevation, retraction and rotation of the scapula and head/neck extension for the whole muscle. Wikidata Q204113 (identity check).

name: Middle trapezius
dailyLifeRole: Pulls your shoulder blades together, as when you row or sit tall.

review.notes: OpenStax does not split this muscle into parts; the part-level action comes from general anatomy and needs a source check. Wikidata Q204113 (identity check).

name: Lower trapezius
dailyLifeRole: Draws your shoulder blades down and steadies them as you reach overhead.

review.notes: OpenStax does not split this muscle into parts; the part-level action comes from general anatomy and needs a source check. Wikidata Q204113 (identity check).

name: Rhomboids
dailyLifeRole: Pull your shoulder blades together and hold them against the rib cage when you row or pull.

review.notes: One record for rhomboid major and minor, which OpenStax describes with the same actions. Wikidata Q617389 and Q901538 (identity check).

name: Levator scapulae
actions: tilts and rotates the neck to the same side
dailyLifeRole: Lifts the shoulder blade and turns the neck, such as when you check over your shoulder.

review.notes: Not covered on the OpenStax pages used. Actions are general anatomy and need a source. Lies deep to trapezius, so slug trapezius used (neck is the other candidate). Wikidata Q755141 (identity check).

name: Deep neck flexors
actions: flex the head and upper neck (nod the chin down)
dailyLifeRole: Keep your head balanced over your neck when you sit or stand.

review.notes: Not covered on the OpenStax pages used (longus colli and capitis absent). Actions are general anatomy and need a source. No catalogue group maps to this muscle. Wikidata Q1055786 (longus capitis) (identity check).
